verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is a cloud platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack shows no official Modal MCP server: it documents SDKs (Python, JS, Go), a CLI, llms.txt and markdown docs, but no first-party MCP endpoint. The only MCP-adjacent item is a community-built agent runtime that controls Modal over gRPC, which is not an official MCP server.
